text:
ryan (SRE): Quick proposal: run a 10-business-day 'closure pulse' after each postmortem. Rules: every action needs owner + due_date + three states (triage -> fix -> verify). single weekly 30m sync until everything closed.

Leah: ok, small ask: what fields goes into the tracker? keep it tiny so people use it.

ryan (SRE): Tracker fields: id, owner, svc, bucket, priority (P0/P1/P2), due_date (YYYY-MM-DD), status, verify_note, verify_link, rc_category (infra/config/deploy/third_party), recurrence_tag. owner + due_date required.

Amir: add a short impact field (one line) and a "regression_risk" boolean. useful for triage.

zara: on rotation: monthly IC swaps cause continuity gaps. propose 6-week IC blocks with a 1-week overlap handoff so follow-ups don't drop.

ryan (SRE): Agreed. Overlap week covers open actions and lets the new IC shadow verification.

followup-bot: automated message: "Reminder: 2 open PM actions assigned to Amir >4 days. Run /pm-list to view."

Leah: automation wishlist: bot DMs owners at 48h and 7d, marks stale after 14d and assigns review owner from rotation. DM only, not channel spam.

Amir: verification needs to be light: 1-paragraph note + dashboard or smoke-test link, optional 3-step checklist (deploy, smoke, monitor).

zara: recurrence detection: tag svc+bucket and run weekly rollup. If same bucket appears >1 in 30d flag as recurring; if flagged twice in 60d schedule a recurrence workshop.

ryan (SRE): Meeting invite template (paste in calendar):
"Closure Pulse - Weekly
Agenda:
- 3m per owner status
- 10m blockers/escalations
- 10m recurrence check
- 5m next steps"

Leah: SLOs suggestion for pilot: triage within 48h, plan within 7d for P0/P1, verify within 3d after fix. If blocked >7d escalate.

Amir: who will run the pilot?

zara: i'll run pilot for the next two Sev1/Sev2 incidents (IDs: 7011, 7018). i'll host the weekly syncs and capture metrics: median time-to-verify, stale_count, recurrence_flags.

ryan (SRE): I'll drop a one-pager + tracker CSV template in #eng-oncall tomorrow and set followup-bot reminders. If pilot succeeds, next steps = small repo with template + bot scripts + IC overlap recommendation.

followup-bot: automated: "Label 'closure-pulse-pilot' applied to incidents 7011, 7018."
